"""Use official app-server proxy only, after checking current-thread ownership."""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import queue
import subprocess
import threading
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OUT = ROOT / "data/temp/active_mcp_reload_20261027_01.json"
CLI = "C:/Users/s0109/AppData/Roaming/npm/node_modules/@openai/codex/node_modules/@openai/codex-win32-x64/vendor/x86_64-pc-windows-msvc/bin/codex.exe"
record = dict(started_at_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), cli=CLI,
              reload_method_sent=False, reload_succeeded=False, initialization_succeeded=False,
              configuration_files_modified=False, existing_app_or_daemon_terminated=False)
if OUT.exists():
    raise FileExistsError(OUT)
process = subprocess.Popen([CLI,"app-server","proxy"], cwd=ROOT, stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
    stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, encoding="utf-8", creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW)
messages, stderr_count = queue.Queue(), [0]
def read_stdout():
    for line in process.stdout:
        try: messages.put(json.loads(line))
        except json.JSONDecodeError: pass
def read_stderr():
    for _ in process.stderr: stderr_count[0] += 1
threading.Thread(target=read_stdout,daemon=True).start()
threading.Thread(target=read_stderr,daemon=True).start()
def send(value):
    process.stdin.write(json.dumps(value)+"\n")
    process.stdin.flush()
def request(identifier, method, params):
    send(dict(id=identifier,method=method,params=params))
    deadline=time.monotonic()+12
    while time.monotonic()<deadline:
        try: response=messages.get(timeout=.1)
        except queue.Empty:
            if process.poll() is not None: raise RuntimeError("Proxy exited before response")
            continue
        if response.get("id")==identifier:
            if "error" in response: raise RuntimeError(f"RPC error in {method}, code={response['error'].get('code')}")
            return response.get("result")
    raise TimeoutError(method+" did not respond")
try:
    request(1,"initialize",dict(clientInfo=dict(name="gui-capture-recovery",version="1")))
    record["initialization_succeeded"]=True
    send(dict(method="initialized"))
    current=os.environ.get("CODEX_THREAD_ID")
    record["current_thread_environment_available"]=bool(current)
    loaded=request(2,"thread/loaded/list",dict(limit=100))
    ids=loaded.get("data",[])
    record["loaded_thread_count"]=len(ids)
    record["current_thread_loaded"]=bool(current and current in ids)
    if not record["current_thread_loaded"]:
        record["status"]="ownership_not_established_no_reload"
    else:
        status=request(3,"mcpServerStatus/list",dict(serverName="node_repl",threadId=current,detail="toolsAndAuthOnly"))
        record["current_node_server_found"]=any(row.get("name")=="node_repl" for row in status.get("data",[]))
        if not record["current_node_server_found"]:
            raise RuntimeError("Current thread node_repl server not found")
        record["reload_method_sent"]=True
        response=request(4,"config/mcpServer/reload",None)
        record["reload_succeeded"]=True
        record["status"]="reload_acknowledged_capture_not_yet_retested"
except Exception as exc:
    record["status"]="proxy_recovery_incomplete"
    record["error_type"]=type(exc).__name__
    record["error"]=str(exc)
finally:
    if process.poll() is None:
        process.stdin.close()
        try: process.wait(timeout=2)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            process.terminate()  # This newly created proxy client only; never the daemon.
            process.wait(timeout=2)
    record["proxy_stderr_line_count"]=stderr_count[0]
    record["finished_at_utc"]=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    with OUT.open("x",encoding="utf-8",newline="\n") as stream:
        json.dump(record,stream,indent=2)
        stream.write("\n")
print(json.dumps(record))
